purgeEmbargo.rule: Between last usable DEV asOf calendar day and first OOS asOf calendar day, exclude ≥ calendarGapTradingDays trading day(s). Additionally forbid any DEV asOf whose (asOf + outcomeHorizonMinutes) overlaps the purge window. Session buffer = one full NY RTH session (09:30–16:00 ET = 390m) to reduce session-structure leakage across the split boundary.
